body.x: Rocketbook participated in ‘2018 CES SHOWSTOPPERS’ held in Las Vegas on 9th (U.S. time standard) and introduced an intelligent notebook ‘Wave’, possible to transmit memo contents.

Rocketbook Wave is an 80-page spiral notebook that scans each page on a Rocketbook application and sends it to the cloud or address users want. At the bottom of each page, there are seven icons for specific storage, box form, Google drive, One Drive, One Note, Evernote, Slack, and e-mail, so users can send what they wrote to anywhere they want.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
